name: 321026SG0ABK00A01
title: 3210 series 2.54 mm box header, 8.8 mm tall, straight through-hole, 6 to 64 pins (321026SG0ABK00A01 is the 26-pin size)
summary: A shrouded, keyed two-row male header on a 2.54 mm grid with straight 0.64 mm square brass pins for through-hole soldering. The housing is 8.8 mm tall and has a 4.5 mm polarising slot in the middle of one long wall. The 3210 family is ordered from 6 to 64 pins with a choice of contact plating, housing plastic and packing; 321026SG0ABK00A01 is the 26-pin (2 x 13) size with gold flash contacts, PBT housing, packed in trays. Rated 3.0 A, 1000 V AC/DC withstand, -40 to +105 °C.

operation.text: Pins are numbered in pairs across the two rows: 1, 3, 5 and so on along the row on the slotted wall, 2, 4, 6 and so on along the other row, pin 1 at one end.
A slot 4.5 mm wide and 6.9 mm deep from the top is cut in the middle of the long wall beside the odd-numbered row.

Straight square pins of 0.64 mm go through holes of Ø1.02 mm on a 2.54 mm grid, rows 2.54 mm apart. The recommended board layout carries a tolerance of ±0.05 mm. The housing has small standoffs on its underside; the 3.3 mm pin length is measured from them. Peak processing is 180 °C for 30 to 60 s, or 200 °C for 10 s.

The housing is 8.8 ± 0.25 mm tall and 8.7 ± 0.25 mm wide, 8.9 ± 0.25 mm across its widest point; the cavity is 6.7 mm wide. Pins stand 5.7 mm above the cavity floor, reach 3.3 ± 0.25 mm below the housing and are 11.5 mm long in all.
